/.alt: Local Operator Docs. Run agents where your work lives.. Guides for the Local Operator agent runtime: the terminal UI, the desktop app, workflow automations, remote access, and building on top of it.

/getting-started/what-is-local-operator.alt: Local Operator Docs. What is Local Operator?. Local Operator is an agent runtime that runs on your machine — one runtime every surface, from the terminal to your phone.

/getting-started/install.alt: Local Operator Docs. Install & first run. Install the Local Operator runtime with pip, pipx, or uv, grab the desktop app, or run it with Docker or Nix — then verify the install.

/getting-started/quickstart.alt: Local Operator Docs. Quickstart. Sign in to a provider, launch the terminal UI, run your first task, and approve a tool call — the five-minute first-run path.

/getting-started/choose-your-surface.alt: Local Operator Docs. Choose your surface. TUI, desktop app, mobile relay, browser extension, exec mode, or the Python SDK — which surface to pick, and when.

/getting-started/updating.alt: Local Operator Docs. Updating Local Operator. Update the runtime with lop update or /update, upgrade an install by hand, and find release notes.

/tui/quickstart.alt: Local Operator Docs. The terminal UI. Launch, read, and drive the terminal UI — the transcript, the keys worth knowing, and the slash commands that matter.

/surfaces/desktop.alt: Local Operator Docs. Desktop app. Install the desktop app, sign in, and learn the window — chat with run details, the tool trace, projects, schedules, themes, and the Agent hub inside the app.

/surfaces/browser-extension.alt: Local Operator Docs. Browser extension. Give the agent the browser you are already signed into — install from the Chrome Web Store, pair the bridge, and know exactly what it can and cannot do.

/capabilities/always-on.alt: Local Operator Docs. Always-on & proactive agents. Sessions that start their own turns — scheduled wakes that fire with every terminal closed, the supervisor that runs them, and Aida, the built-in chief of staff.

/capabilities/agent-hub.alt: Local Operator Docs. Agent Hub. Browse Radient's community registry of agents, pull one into your setup, publish your own, and share privately with a team.

/build/exec-mode.alt: Local Operator Docs. Exec mode. Run Local Operator headless — one-shot prompts, JSON event streams, background jobs, goal loops, and CI usage.

/build/python-sdk.alt: Local Operator Docs. Python SDK. Drive sessions from Python — open or spawn one, deliver prompts, stream typed events, and collect results, with explicit roots and an approval policy.

/build/sse-streaming.alt: Local Operator Docs. SSE streaming. Embed an agent runtime behind a Server-Sent Events stream — endpoint shape, event taxonomy, resuming with Last-Event-ID, keepalives, and working examples.

/ecosystem.alt: Local Operator Docs. What's in the ecosystem. The pieces around the runtime — model providers, Radient, MCP servers, skills, teams, the Agent Hub, and the browser extension.

/about/why.alt: Local Operator Docs. Why Local Operator. What Local Operator does differently — everything on your machine, one runtime for every surface, a mesh across your computers, and when a different tool fits better.

/about/faq.alt: Local Operator Docs. FAQ. Short answers to the questions people ask first — privacy, accounts, models, cost, offline use, platforms and updates.
